name: lotus flower
author: min479
description: Time a click shortly after falling into the UFO portal at 22% to fall below the gameplay between the decoration. Stay under the decorations hitboxes while staying above the levels invisible saws. At 24%, you need to go slightly under the saw with rotating spikes, time a click where your icon gets close to hitting the bottom of it and then slowly have your icon move up until 25% where you can start spamming to make it above the gameplay as the UFO. Continue spamming until your icon makes it near the ceiling. Stay at a constant position, near the ceiling until the end from there.
